options.title: Investors Passed on Airbnb. Cereal Kept It Alive
options.first_line: Investors passed on Airbnb, so its founders kept it alive with cereal.
options.first_frame: A CNBC report card about Airbnb's founders and boxes of cereal, the price of one box highlighted in yellow and the Airbnb logo on it, then a cut to a bowl of cereal.

options.title: Airbnb Survived 2008 by Selling Election Cereal
options.first_line: Airbnb got through two thousand eight by selling election cereal.
options.first_frame: A typeset news card: 'boxes of cereal' highlighted under the Airbnb logo, then a cut to a cereal bowl in milk.

options.title: Airbnb's Founders Sold Cereal at {fact1} a Box
options.first_line: Airbnb's founders sold cereal at {fact1} a box to keep their company alive.
options.first_frame: A news card with '{fact1} a box' highlighted and the Airbnb logo, then three cereal boxes on top of a fridge.

why: A box of cereal at a price far above what anyone pays makes a stranger ask how Airbnb got people to pay that, and the answer only comes by staying, while B's title already gives the twist and A's cereal is vaguer.
